authors: Espeholt L, Soyer H, Munos R, Simonyan K, Mnih V, Ward T, et al.
summary: Separates acting from learning across many machines and corrects for policy lag with V-trace off-policy importance weighting. It enabled high-throughput multi-task training and influenced large systems such as AlphaStar.

title: QMIX: Monotonic Value Function Factorisation for Deep Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Rashid T, Samvelyan M, Schroeder de Witt C, Farquhar G, Foerster J, Whiteson S
summary: Combines per-agent Q-values with a monotonic mixing network conditioned on the global state, enabling centralized training with decentralized execution. A standard method for cooperative multi-agent RL such as StarCraft micromanagement.

title: QT-Opt: Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Based Robotic Manipulation
authors: Kalashnikov D, Irpan A, Pastor P, Ibarz J, Herzog A, Jang E, et al.
summary: Large-scale off-policy Q-learning with continuous actions chosen by cross-entropy-method optimization, trained on 580k real grasp attempts across a fleet of robots. It reached a 96% grasp success rate on unseen objects.

title: Rainbow: Combining Improvements in Deep Reinforcement Learning
authors: Hessel M, Modayil J, van Hasselt H, Schaul T, Ostrovski G, Dabney W, et al.
summary: Combined six DQN extensions (double Q, prioritized replay, dueling, multi-step, distributional, noisy nets) and measured each one's contribution with ablations. Rainbow set a new state of the art on Atari for data efficiency.

title: Soft Actor-Critic: Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep Reinforcement Learning with a Stochastic Actor
authors: Haarnoja T, Zhou A, Abbeel P, Levine S
summary: SAC optimizes reward plus policy entropy with an off-policy stochastic actor-critic, giving sample efficiency, stability and good exploration. It became a leading algorithm for continuous control and real-robot learning.

title: Superhuman AI for heads-up no-limit poker: Libratus beats top professionals
authors: Brown N, Sandholm T
summary: Libratus combined a game-theoretic blueprint strategy computed by CFR variants with real-time nested subgame solving and self-improvement. It decisively beat four top poker professionals.

title: World Models
authors: Ha D, Schmidhuber J
venue: arXiv 2018; NeurIPS 2018 as 'Recurrent World Models Facilitate Policy Evolution'
summary: Trains a VAE and a mixture-density RNN as a generative world model, then trains a compact controller inside the model's 'dream'. It revived interest in learned latent world models.

title: CRISPR-Cas12a target binding unleashes indiscriminate single-stranded DNase activity
authors: Chen JS, Ma E, Harrington LB, Da Costa M, Tian X, Palefsky JM, et al.
summary: Discovered Cas12a collateral ssDNase activity and built DETECTR for rapid HPV detection.

title: Detection and localization of surgically resectable cancers with a multi-analyte blood test
authors: Cohen JD, Li L, Wang Y, Thoburn C, Afsari B, Danilova L, et al.
summary: CancerSEEK combined ctDNA mutations and protein markers for multi-cancer early detection.

title: Patisiran, an RNAi therapeutic, for hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis
authors: Adams D, Gonzalez-Duarte A, O'Riordan WD, Yang CC, Ueda M, Kristen AV, et al.
summary: APOLLO trial leading to patisiran, the first approved siRNA drug and first LNP-delivered RNA medicine.

title: Deep learning enables rapid identification of potent DDR1 kinase inhibitors
authors: Zhavoronkov A, Ivanenkov YA, Aliper A, Veselov MS, Aladinskiy VA, Aladinskaya AV, et al.
summary: GENTRL, a generative reinforcement-learning model, designed DDR1 inhibitors validated in cells and mice within weeks.

title: Ultra-large library docking for discovering new chemotypes
authors: Lyu J, Wang S, Balius TE, Singh I, Levit A, Moroz YS, et al.
summary: Docked ~170 million make-on-demand molecules, finding potent novel ligands and showing hit rates improve with library scale.

title: A Style-Based Generator Architecture for Generative Adversarial Networks
authors: Karras T, Laine S, Aila T
summary: StyleGAN: mapping network and AdaIN style modulation giving disentangled control and state-of-the-art photorealism; introduced FFHQ.

title: EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for Convolutional Neural Networks
authors: Tan M, Le QV
summary: Compound scaling of depth, width and resolution on a NAS-found base network, giving strong accuracy-efficiency trade-offs.

title: SlowFast Networks for Video Recognition
authors: Feichtenhofer C, Fan H, Malik J, He K
summary: Two pathways at low and high frame rates capturing semantics and motion, a strong video recognition backbone.

title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
authors: Loshchilov I, Hutter F
summary: Introduced AdamW, decoupling weight decay from adaptive gradient updates; the standard optimizer for training Transformers and LLMs.

title: Generative Modeling by Estimating Gradients of the Data Distribution
authors: Song Y, Ermon S
summary: Introduced noise-conditional score networks sampled with annealed Langevin dynamics, establishing score-based generative modeling.

title: How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?
authors: Xu K, Hu W, Leskovec J, Jegelka S
summary: Related message-passing GNN expressivity to the Weisfeiler-Lehman test and proposed the maximally expressive GIN.

title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism
authors: Shoeybi M, Patwary M, Puri R, LeGresley P, Casper J, Catanzaro B
summary: Efficient intra-layer tensor parallelism for Transformers, a cornerstone of large-scale LLM training.

title: PyTorch: An Imperative Style, High-Performance Deep Learning Library
authors: Paszke A, Gross S, Massa F, Lerer A, Bradbury J, Chanan G, et al.
summary: Define-by-run framework with eager execution and dynamic autograd that became the dominant deep-learning library.

title: Reconciling Modern Machine-Learning Practice and the Classical Bias-Variance Trade-off
authors: Belkin M, Hsu D, Ma S, Mandal S
summary: Identified the double-descent risk curve, in which test error falls again beyond the interpolation threshold.

title: The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: Finding Sparse, Trainable Neural Networks
authors: Frankle J, Carbin M
summary: Showed dense networks contain sparse subnetworks that, from their original initialization, train to full accuracy.

title: Accurate circular consensus long-read sequencing improves variant detection and assembly of a human genome
authors: Wenger AM, Peluso P, Rowell WJ, Chang PC, Hall RJ, Concepcion GT, et al.
summary: PacBio HiFi circular consensus sequencing giving long reads at >99% accuracy, transforming genome assembly and variant calling.

title: Slide-seq: a scalable technology for measuring genome-wide expression at high spatial resolution
authors: Rodriques SG, Stickels RR, Goeva A, Martin CA, Murray E, Vanderburg CR, et al.
summary: Spatial transcriptomics on surfaces of DNA-barcoded beads at 10 micron resolution.

title: Search-and-replace genome editing without double-strand breaks or donor DNA
authors: Anzalone AV, Randolph PB, Davis JR, Sousa AA, Koblan LW, Levy JM, et al.
summary: Prime editing: a Cas9 nickase fused to reverse transcriptase writes new sequence from an extended guide RNA, enabling insertions, deletions and all base changes.

title: Total synthesis of Escherichia coli with a recoded genome
authors: Fredens J, Wang K, de la Torre D, Funke LFH, Robertson WE, Christova Y, et al.
summary: Syn61: a 4 Mb synthetic E. coli genome using 61 rather than 64 codons, freeing codons for genetic code expansion and virus resistance.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
authors: Devlin J, Chang MW, Lee K, Toutanova K
summary: Pretrained a bidirectional Transformer encoder with masked language modeling and next-sentence prediction, setting new records on GLUE and SQuAD and defining the pretrained-encoder era.

title: DistilBERT, a Distilled Version of BERT: Smaller, Faster, Cheaper and Lighter
authors: Sanh V, Debut L, Chaumond J, Wolf T
summary: Distilled BERT during pretraining into a 40% smaller model retaining about 97% of its language-understanding performance.

title: Fine-Tuning Language Models from Human Preferences
authors: Ziegler DM, Stiennon N, Wu J, Brown TB, Radford A, Amodei D, et al.
summary: First application of reward modeling from human comparisons plus PPO to fine-tune pretrained language models.

title: GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Natural Language Understanding
authors: Wang A, Singh A, Michael J, Hill F, Levy O, Bowman SR
summary: Nine-task NLU benchmark with a single leaderboard that became the yardstick for pretrained encoders such as BERT.

title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
authors: Radford A, Wu J, Child R, Luan D, Amodei D, Sutskever I
summary: GPT-2: a 1.5B-parameter decoder trained on WebText that performed many tasks zero-shot, showing scale alone yields broad capabilities.

title: RoBERTa: A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
authors: Liu Y, Ott M, Goyal N, Du J, Joshi M, Chen D, et al.
summary: Showed BERT was undertrained; more data, longer training, dynamic masking and dropping NSP gave large gains.

title: SuperGLUE: A Stickier Benchmark for General-Purpose Language Understanding Systems
authors: Wang A, Pruksachatkun Y, Nangia N, Singh A, Michael J, Hill F, et al.
summary: Harder successor to GLUE created after pretrained models surpassed human baselines on the original benchmark.

title: XLNet: Generalized Autoregressive Pretraining for Language Understanding
authors: Yang Z, Dai Z, Yang Y, Carbonell J, Salakhutdinov R, Le QV
summary: Permutation language modeling combining autoregressive training with bidirectional context, outperforming BERT on many benchmarks.

title: Dota 2 with Large Scale Deep Reinforcement Learning
authors: Berner C, Brockman G, Chan B, Cheung V, Debiak P, Dennison C, et al.
summary: OpenAI Five trained LSTM policies with PPO self-play at very large scale and defeated the reigning Dota 2 world champions in 2019. It showed that scaled-up policy gradients can handle long-horizon team games.

title: Exploration by Random Network Distillation
authors: Burda Y, Edwards H, Storkey A, Klimov O
summary: RND uses as a novelty bonus the error of a network trained to predict the outputs of a fixed random network. It was the first method to beat average human performance on Montezuma's Revenge without demonstrations.

title: Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning
authors: Vinyals O, Babuschkin I, Czarnecki WM, Mathieu M, Dudzik A, Chung J, et al.
summary: AlphaStar reached Grandmaster level in StarCraft II by combining imitation learning, off-policy actor-critic RL and a league of agents playing against each other. It mastered a real-time, partially observed game with a huge action space.

title: Learning Latent Dynamics for Planning from Pixels
authors: Hafner D, Lillicrap TP, Fischer I, Villegas R, Ha D, Lee H, et al.
summary: PlaNet learns a recurrent state-space model with deterministic and stochastic paths and plans in its latent space from images. It is the direct precursor of the Dreamer agents.

title: Learning agile and dynamic motor skills for legged robots
authors: Hwangbo J, Lee J, Dosovitskiy A, Bellicoso D, Tsounis V, Koltun V, et al.
summary: Trained neural network policies in simulation, using a learned actuator model, and transferred them to the ANYmal quadruped. They gave agile locomotion and fall recovery beyond what hand-designed controllers achieved.

title: Off-Policy Deep Reinforcement Learning without Exploration
authors: Fujimoto S, Meger D, Precup D
summary: Identified extrapolation error as the reason off-policy methods fail on fixed datasets and proposed Batch-Constrained Q-learning (BCQ), which keeps actions close to the data. It started the modern deep offline RL line.

title: Recurrent Experience Replay in Distributed Reinforcement Learning
authors: Kapturowski S, Ostrovski G, Quan J, Munos R, Dabney W
summary: R2D2 trains recurrent Q-networks from distributed prioritized replay, using stored states and burn-in to handle stale recurrent states. It sharply raised Atari performance.

title: Solving Rubik's Cube with a Robot Hand
authors: OpenAI, Akkaya I, Andrychowicz M, Chociej M, Litwin M, McGrew B, et al.
summary: Trained a Shadow Dexterous Hand in simulation with PPO and Automatic Domain Randomization to manipulate and solve a Rubik's Cube in the real world. A landmark of sim-to-real dexterous manipulation.

title: Superhuman AI for multiplayer poker
authors: Brown N, Sandholm T
summary: Pluribus beat elite professionals at six-player no-limit hold'em using self-play blueprint strategies and depth-limited search. It was the first superhuman result in a major multiplayer game.

title: When to Trust Your Model: Model-Based Policy Optimization
authors: Janner M, Fu J, Zhang M, Levine S
summary: MBPO generates short model rollouts that branch from real states and trains SAC on them, analyzing when model use helps. It achieved strong sample efficiency on continuous control.

title: A deep learning approach to antibiotic discovery
authors: Stokes JM, Yang K, Swanson K, Jin W, Cubillos-Ruiz A, Donghia NM, et al.
summary: A graph neural network screen identified halicin, a structurally novel broad-spectrum antibiotic, showcasing deep learning for drug discovery.

title: Elicitation of potent neutralizing antibody responses by designed protein nanoparticle vaccines for SARS-CoV-2
authors: Walls AC, Fiala B, Schäfer A, Wrenn S, Pham MN, Murphy M, et al.
summary: A computationally designed two-component nanoparticle displaying the spike RBD; it became SKYCovione, the first approved vaccine built on a de novo designed protein.

title: Improved protein structure prediction using potentials from deep learning
authors: Senior AW, Evans R, Jumper J, Kirkpatrick J, Sifre L, Green T, et al.
summary: AlphaFold (CASP13) predicted inter-residue distance distributions with deep networks and folded proteins by gradient descent on the resulting potential.

title: Improved protein structure prediction using predicted interresidue orientations
authors: Yang J, Anishchenko I, Park H, Peng Z, Ovchinnikov S, Baker D
summary: trRosetta predicted inter-residue distances and orientations to drive Rosetta folding, a fast open alternative to AlphaFold 1.

title: Single-particle cryo-EM at atomic resolution
authors: Nakane T, Kotecha A, Sente A, McMullan G, Masiulis S, Brown PMGE, et al.
summary: Reached ~1.2 Å resolution for apoferritin, resolving individual atoms and hydrogens and establishing cryo-EM as a true atomic-resolution method.

title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
authors: Chen T, Kornblith S, Norouzi M, Hinton G
summary: SimCLR: in-batch contrastive learning with strong augmentation and a projection head, showing the key ingredients of contrastive SSL.

title: Bootstrap Your Own Latent: A New Approach to Self-Supervised Learning
authors: Grill JB, Strub F, Altché F, Tallec C, Richemond PH, Buchatskaya E, et al.
summary: BYOL: self-supervised learning without negatives via an online network predicting a momentum target network.

title: End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers
authors: Carion N, Massa F, Synnaeve G, Usunier N, Kirillov A, Zagoruyko S
summary: DETR: set prediction with a transformer encoder-decoder and Hungarian matching, removing anchors and NMS.

title: Momentum Contrast for Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning
authors: He K, Fan H, Wu Y, Xie S, Girshick R
summary: MoCo: contrastive learning with a queue of negatives and a momentum encoder, rivaling supervised pre-training for transfer.

title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
authors: Mildenhall B, Srinivasan PP, Tancik M, Barron JT, Ramamoorthi R, Ng R
summary: Represented a scene as an MLP mapping position and view direction to density and color, rendered by differentiable volume rendering for photorealistic novel view synthesis.

title: RAFT: Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms for Optical Flow
authors: Teed Z, Deng J
summary: All-pairs correlation volumes with recurrent iterative updates; ECCV 2020 best paper and a new optical flow standard.

title: Deep Double Descent: Where Bigger Models and More Data Hurt
authors: Nakkiran P, Kaplun G, Bansal Y, Yang T, Barak B, Sutskever I
summary: Showed model-wise, epoch-wise and sample-wise double descent across modern deep architectures.

title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
authors: Ho J, Jain A, Abbeel P
summary: Simplified diffusion training to a noise-prediction objective and achieved high-quality image synthesis, triggering the diffusion boom.

title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
authors: Kaplan J, McCandlish S, Henighan T, Brown TB, Chess B, Child R, et al.
summary: Found smooth power laws relating language-model loss to parameters, data and compute, guiding the scale-up of LLMs.

title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
authors: Rajbhandari S, Rasley J, Ruwase O, He Y
summary: Partitioned optimizer states, gradients and parameters across data-parallel workers (DeepSpeed), removing memory redundancy.

title: Zoom In: An Introduction to Circuits
authors: Olah C, Cammarata N, Schubert L, Goh G, Petrov M, Carter S
summary: Articulated the circuits program of mechanistic interpretability: features and circuits as fundamental, reverse-engineerable units of networks.

title: Expanded encyclopaedias of DNA elements in the human and mouse genomes
authors: ENCODE Project Consortium, Moore JE, Purcaro MJ, Pratt HE, Epstein CB, Shoresh N, et al.
summary: ENCODE phase 3 with a registry of ~926,000 human and ~339,000 mouse candidate cis-regulatory elements.

title: Pan-cancer analysis of whole genomes
authors: ICGC/TCGA Pan-Cancer Analysis of Whole Genomes Consortium
summary: Whole-genome analysis of 2,658 cancers revealing non-coding drivers, chromothripsis and structural variation.

title: Telomere-to-telomere assembly of a complete human X chromosome
authors: Miga KH, Koren S, Rhie A, Vollger MR, Gershman A, Bzikadze A, et al.
summary: First gapless telomere-to-telomere human chromosome, including the X centromere, from ultra-long nanopore reads.

title: The GTEx Consortium atlas of genetic regulatory effects across human tissues
authors: GTEx Consortium
summary: GTEx v8: eQTLs and sQTLs in 49 tissues from 838 donors, a central resource for interpreting GWAS loci.

title: The mutational constraint spectrum quantified from variation in 141,456 humans
authors: Karczewski KJ, Francioli LC, Tiao G, Cummings BB, Alföldi J, Wang Q, et al.
summary: gnomAD exomes and genomes defining loss-of-function constraint (LOEUF), central to rare-disease variant interpretation.

title: BART: Denoising Sequence-to-Sequence Pre-training for Natural Language Generation, Translation, and Comprehension
authors: Lewis M, Liu Y, Goyal N, Ghazvininejad M, Mohamed A, Levy O, et al.
summary: Denoising autoencoder pretraining for an encoder-decoder Transformer, strong for summarization and generation.

title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
authors: Karpukhin V, Oğuz B, Min S, Lewis P, Wu L, Edunov S, et al.
summary: Dual-encoder BERT retriever trained with in-batch negatives that outperformed BM25 for open-domain QA.

title: ELECTRA: Pre-training Text Encoders as Discriminators Rather Than Generators
authors: Clark K, Luong MT, Le QV, Manning CD
summary: Replaced-token detection pretraining that is far more compute-efficient than masked language modeling.

title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
authors: Raffel C, Shazeer N, Roberts A, Lee K, Narang S, Matena M, et al.
summary: T5: cast every NLP task as text-to-text, released the C4 corpus and systematically studied pretraining objectives and scale.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
authors: Brown TB, Mann B, Ryder N, Subbiah M, Kaplan J, Dhariwal P, et al.
summary: GPT-3: a 175B-parameter language model demonstrating in-context few-shot learning from prompts alone, launching the large language model era.

title: Learning to Summarize from Human Feedback
authors: Stiennon N, Ouyang L, Wu J, Ziegler DM, Lowe R, Voss C, et al.
summary: Showed RLHF summarization policies outperform supervised models and larger references, demonstrating the RLHF recipe at scale.

title: REALM: Retrieval-Augmented Language Model Pre-Training
authors: Guu K, Lee K, Tung Z, Pasupat P, Chang MW
summary: Pretrained a masked LM jointly with a learned neural retriever over Wikipedia, improving open-domain QA with interpretable knowledge access.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
authors: Lewis P, Perez E, Piktus A, Petroni F, Karpukhin V, Goyal N, et al.
summary: RAG: combined a DPR retriever with a BART generator end to end, grounding generation in retrieved documents; the basis of retrieval-augmented LLM systems.

title: Agent57: Outperforming the Atari Human Benchmark
authors: Badia AP, Piot B, Kapturowski S, Sprechmann P, Vitvitskyi A, Guo D, et al.
summary: First agent to exceed the human baseline on all 57 Atari games, including hard-exploration games like Montezuma's Revenge. It combines R2D2 and Never Give Up's intrinsic rewards with a meta-controller that picks exploration policies.

title: Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning
authors: Kumar A, Zhou A, Tucker G, Levine S
summary: CQL regularizes Q-values so that the learned values lower-bound the true policy value, preventing overestimation on out-of-distribution actions. A leading offline RL algorithm.

title: D4RL: Datasets for Deep Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning
authors: Fu J, Kumar A, Nachum O, Tucker G, Levine S
summary: A benchmark suite of offline RL datasets covering locomotion, mazes and manipulation, collected with a range of data-generating policies. It became the standard offline RL benchmark.

title: Dream to Control: Learning Behaviors by Latent Imagination
authors: Hafner D, Lillicrap T, Ba J, Norouzi M
summary: Dreamer learns actor and critic entirely from imagined latent trajectories, backpropagating value gradients through the learned dynamics. It outperformed model-free agents on visual control.

title: Mastering Atari, Go, chess and shogi by planning with a learned model
authors: Schrittwieser J, Antonoglou I, Hubert T, Simonyan K, Sifre L, Schmitt S, et al.
summary: MuZero runs MCTS with a learned model that predicts only reward, value and policy, without being given the rules. It matched AlphaZero in board games and set a new state of the art on Atari.

title: Never Give Up: Learning Directed Exploration Strategies
authors: Badia AP, Sprechmann P, Vitvitskyi A, Guo D, Piot B, Kapturowski S, et al.
summary: Combines episodic novelty with RND-based lifelong novelty in an intrinsic reward and learns a family of policies with different exploration levels. It was a key component of Agent57.

title: An mRNA vaccine against SARS-CoV-2 — preliminary report
authors: Jackson LA, Anderson EJ, Rouphael NG, Roberts PC, Makhene M, Coler RN, et al.
summary: First-in-human phase 1 results for mRNA-1273, showing robust neutralizing responses within months of the viral sequence release.

title: CRISPR–Cas12-based detection of SARS-CoV-2
authors: Broughton JP, Deng X, Yu G, Fasching CL, Servellita V, Singh J, et al.
summary: DETECTR-based lateral-flow SARS-CoV-2 assay, among the first clinical CRISPR diagnostics.

title: Detection of 2019 novel coronavirus (2019-nCoV) by real-time RT-PCR
authors: Corman VM, Landt O, Kaiser M, Molenkamp R, Meijer A, Chu DKW, et al.
summary: The first validated SARS-CoV-2 RT-qPCR protocol, distributed worldwide by WHO in January 2020.

title: Discriminative accuracy of plasma phospho-tau217 for Alzheimer disease vs other neurodegenerative disorders
authors: Palmqvist S, Janelidze S, Quiroz YT, Zetterberg H, Lopera F, Stomrud E, et al.
summary: Plasma p-tau217 matched PET and CSF for Alzheimer's diagnosis, leading to blood-based Alzheimer's tests cleared from 2025.

title: Safety and efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 vaccine
authors: Polack FP, Thomas SJ, Kitchin N, Absalon J, Gurtman A, Lockhart S, et al.
summary: Phase 3 trial showing 95% efficacy of the Pfizer-BioNTech nucleoside-modified mRNA-LNP vaccine; first mRNA product ever authorized.

title: Two phase 3 trials of inclisiran in patients with elevated LDL cholesterol
authors: Ray KK, Wright RS, Kallend D, Koenig W, Leiter LA, Raal FJ, et al.
summary: Twice-yearly GalNAc-siRNA against PCSK9 halved LDL cholesterol, bringing RNAi to common cardiovascular disease.

title: Accurate prediction of protein structures and interactions using a three-track neural network
authors: Baek M, DiMaio F, Anishchenko I, Dauparas J, Ovchinnikov S, Lee GR, et al.
summary: RoseTTAFold jointly reasoned over sequence, distance and 3D coordinates, achieving near-AlphaFold2 accuracy openly and modeling complexes.

title: Biological structure and function emerge from scaling unsupervised learning to 250 million protein sequences
authors: Rives A, Meier J, Sercu T, Goyal S, Lin Z, Liu J, et al.
summary: ESM-1b trained a Transformer masked language model on UniRef protein sequences; its representations encoded structure, contacts and function without supervision.

title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
authors: Jumper J, Evans R, Pritzel A, Green T, Figurnov M, Ronneberger O, et al.
summary: AlphaFold2's Evoformer and structure module reached near-experimental accuracy in CASP14, largely solving single-chain protein structure prediction (Nobel 2024).

title: Protein complex prediction with AlphaFold-Multimer
authors: Evans R, O'Neill M, Pritzel A, Antropova N, Senior A, Green T, et al.
summary: Retrained AlphaFold for multi-chain inputs, substantially improving prediction of protein-protein complexes.

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
authors: Dosovitskiy A, Beyer L, Kolesnikov A, Weissenborn D, Zhai X, Unterthiner T, et al.
summary: Vision Transformer (ViT): a pure Transformer on image patches that matches or beats CNNs when pre-trained at scale, launching transformer-based vision.

title: Deformable DETR: Deformable Transformers for End-to-End Object Detection
authors: Zhu X, Su W, Lu L, Li B, Wang X, Dai J
summary: Sparse multi-scale deformable attention that speeds DETR convergence and improves small-object detection.

title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers
authors: Caron M, Touvron H, Misra I, Jégou H, Mairal J, Bojanowski P, Joulin A
summary: DINO: self-distillation with no labels for ViTs, revealing emergent object segmentation in attention maps and strong k-NN features.

title: Is Space-Time Attention All You Need for Video Understanding?
authors: Bertasius G, Wang H, Torresani L
summary: TimeSformer: convolution-free video transformer with divided space-time attention.

title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
authors: Radford A, Kim JW, Hallacy C, Ramesh A, Goh G, Agarwal S, et al.
summary: CLIP: contrastive image-text pre-training on 400M web pairs, enabling zero-shot classification and becoming the core vision-language component of generative models.

title: Scaling Up Visual and Vision-Language Representation Learning With Noisy Text Supervision
authors: Jia C, Yang Y, Xia Y, Chen YT, Parekh Z, Pham H, et al.
summary: ALIGN: dual-encoder contrastive training on over a billion noisy alt-text pairs, showing scale overcomes noise.

title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows
authors: Liu Z, Lin Y, Cao Y, Hu H, Wei Y, Zhang Z, et al.
summary: Hierarchical transformer backbone with shifted-window local attention, bringing ViTs to dense prediction; ICCV 2021 Marr Prize.

title: Taming Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
authors: Esser P, Rombach R, Ommer B
summary: VQGAN: adversarially trained perceptual codebook plus an autoregressive transformer prior for high-resolution synthesis.

title: Training data-efficient image transformers & distillation through attention
authors: Touvron H, Cord M, Douze M, Massa F, Sablayrolles A, Jégou H
summary: DeiT: trained ViTs competitively on ImageNet-1k alone using strong augmentation and a distillation token.

title: Zero-Shot Text-to-Image Generation
authors: Ramesh A, Pavlov M, Goh G, Gray S, Voss C, Radford A, et al.
summary: DALL-E: a 12B-parameter autoregressive transformer over text and discrete image tokens, demonstrating compositional zero-shot text-to-image generation.

title: A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits
authors: Elhage N, Nanda N, Olsson C, Henighan T, Joseph N, Mann B, et al.
summary: Decomposed attention-only Transformers into interpretable paths, identifying induction heads and founding transformer mechanistic interpretability.

title: Diffusion Models Beat GANs on Image Synthesis
authors: Dhariwal P, Nichol A
summary: Architecture improvements and classifier guidance let diffusion models surpass GANs on ImageNet sample quality.

title: E(n) Equivariant Graph Neural Networks
authors: Satorras VG, Hoogeboom E, Welling M
summary: Simple E(n)-equivariant message passing on coordinates without spherical harmonics, widely used for molecules and generative modeling.

title: Geometric Deep Learning: Grids, Groups, Graphs, Geodesics, and Gauges
authors: Bronstein MM, Bruna J, Cohen T, Veličković P
summary: Unified CNNs, GNNs, Transformers and equivariant networks under a symmetry and invariance-based blueprint.

title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
authors: Song Y, Sohl-Dickstein J, Kingma DP, Kumar A, Ermon S, Poole B
summary: Unified score matching and diffusion as continuous-time SDEs, introducing probability-flow ODEs and exact likelihoods.

title: Effective gene expression prediction from sequence by integrating long-range interactions
authors: Avsec Ž, Agarwal V, Visentin D, Ledsam JR, Grabska-Barwinska A, Taylor KR, et al.
summary: Enformer: transformer predicting expression and chromatin tracks from 200 kb of DNA sequence, improving variant-effect prediction.

title: Haplotype-resolved de novo assembly using phased assembly graphs with hifiasm
authors: Cheng H, Concepcion GT, Feng X, Zhang H, Li H
summary: Fast haplotype-resolved assembler for HiFi reads, central to T2T and pangenome assemblies.

title: CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing for sickle cell disease and β-thalassemia
authors: Frangoul H, Altshuler D, Cappellini MD, Chen YS, Domm J, Eustace BK, et al.
summary: Ex vivo CRISPR editing of BCL11A in patient stem cells produced transfusion independence and freedom from crises, the first clear clinical cures by genome editing.

title: CRISPR-Cas9 in vivo gene editing for transthyretin amyloidosis
authors: Gillmore JD, Gane E, Taubel J, Kao J, Fontana M, Maitland ML, et al.
summary: First demonstration that lipid-nanoparticle-delivered CRISPR can knock out a disease gene in the human liver in vivo.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
authors: Chen M, Tworek J, Jun H, Yuan Q, Pinto HPdO, Kaplan J, et al.
summary: Introduced Codex and the HumanEval benchmark, showing code-trained LLMs can synthesize functional programs from docstrings.

title: Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding
authors: Hendrycks D, Burns C, Basart S, Zou A, Mazeika M, Song D, Steinhardt J
summary: MMLU: 57-subject multiple-choice exam benchmark that became the headline measure of LLM knowledge.

title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
authors: Su J, Lu Y, Pan S, Murtadha A, Wen B, Liu Y
summary: Rotary position embedding (RoPE) encodes relative position by rotating queries and keys, now standard in most LLMs and the basis of context extension.

title: WebGPT: Browser-assisted Question-Answering with Human Feedback
authors: Nakano R, Hilton J, Balaji S, Wu J, Ouyang L, Kim C, et al.
summary: Fine-tuned GPT-3 to search and browse a text web environment and cite sources, an early tool-using LLM agent trained with human feedback.

title: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
authors: Chen L, Lu K, Rajeswaran A, Lee K, Grover A, Laskin M, et al.
summary: Recasts offline RL as conditional sequence modeling: a causal transformer predicts actions conditioned on desired return, past states and past actions. It linked RL with the transformer and language-model paradigm.

title: First return, then explore
authors: Ecoffet A, Huizinga J, Lehman J, Stanley KO, Clune J
summary: Go-Explore keeps an archive of promising states, returns to them, and then explores from there, avoiding 'detachment' and 'derailment'. It solved hard-exploration Atari games such as Montezuma's Revenge and Pitfall at superhuman levels.

title: Mastering Atari with Discrete World Models
authors: Hafner D, Lillicrap T, Norouzi M, Ba J
summary: DreamerV2 uses categorical latent variables and KL balancing. It was the first world-model agent to reach human-level performance on the Atari benchmark when trained purely in imagination.

title: Efficacy and safety of the mRNA-1273 SARS-CoV-2 vaccine
authors: Baden LR, El Sahly HM, Essink B, Kotloff K, Frey S, Novak R, et al.
summary: COVE phase 3 trial showing 94.1% efficacy of Moderna's mRNA-1273, confirming the mRNA vaccine platform.

title: In vivo CRISPR base editing of PCSK9 durably lowers cholesterol in primates
authors: Musunuru K, Chadwick AC, Mizoguchi T, Garcia SP, DeNizio JE, Reiss CW, et al.
summary: LNP-delivered adenine base editor durably knocked down PCSK9 in monkeys, enabling in vivo base-editing therapies.

title: Once-weekly semaglutide in adults with overweight or obesity
authors: Wilding JPH, Batterham RL, Calanna S, Davies M, Van Gaal LF, Lingvay I, et al.
summary: STEP 1 trial showing ~15% weight loss with semaglutide, launching the GLP-1 obesity drug era.

title: Overall survival benefit with tebentafusp in metastatic uveal melanoma
authors: Nathan P, Hassel JC, Rutkowski P, Baurain JJ, Butler MO, Schlaak M, et al.
summary: First TCR-based bispecific (ImmTAC) to improve survival, validating soluble TCR therapeutics against intracellular antigens.

title: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database: massively expanding the structural coverage of protein-sequence space with high-accuracy models
authors: Varadi M, Anyango S, Deshpande M, Nair S, Natassia C, Yordanova G, et al.
summary: The AlphaFold DB with EMBL-EBI, later expanded to over 200 million predicted structures covering nearly all of UniProt.

title: Design of protein-binding proteins from the target structure alone
authors: Cao L, Coventry B, Goreshnik I, Huang B, Sheffler W, Park JS, et al.
summary: A general Rosetta pipeline producing de novo binders to diverse targets using only the target structure.

title: Robust deep learning-based protein sequence design using ProteinMPNN
authors: Dauparas J, Anishchenko I, Bennett N, Bai H, Ragotte RJ, Milles LF, et al.
summary: A message-passing network for inverse folding that designs sequences for backbones with far higher experimental success than Rosetta.

title: A ConvNet for the 2020s
authors: Liu Z, Mao H, Wu CY, Feichtenhofer C, Darrell T, Xie S
summary: ConvNeXt: modernized ResNets with transformer-era design choices, showing pure ConvNets can match Swin Transformers.

title: GLIDE: Towards Photorealistic Image Generation and Editing with Text-Guided Diffusion Models
authors: Nichol A, Dhariwal P, Ramesh A, Shyam P, Mishkin P, McGrew B, et al.
summary: Text-conditional diffusion comparing CLIP guidance with classifier-free guidance, with inpainting-based editing.

title: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents
authors: Ramesh A, Dhariwal P, Nichol A, Chu C, Chen M
summary: DALL-E 2 (unCLIP): a prior maps text to CLIP image embeddings and a diffusion decoder renders them.

title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
authors: Rombach R, Blattmann A, Lorenz D, Esser P, Ommer B
summary: Latent diffusion in a pretrained autoencoder's latent space with cross-attention conditioning; the basis of open-source Stable Diffusion.

title: LAION-5B: An open large-scale dataset for training next generation image-text models
authors: Schuhmann C, Beaumont R, Vencu R, Gordon C, Wightman R, Cherti M, et al.
summary: 5.85B CLIP-filtered web image-text pairs released openly, enabling open CLIP replications and Stable Diffusion training.

title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
authors: He K, Chen X, Xie S, Li Y, Dollár P, Girshick R
summary: MAE: reconstructing pixels from heavily (75%) masked patches with an asymmetric encoder-decoder; simple, scalable ViT pre-training.

title: Masked-attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation
authors: Cheng B, Misra I, Schwing AG, Kirillov A, Girdhar R
summary: Mask2Former: a single mask-classification transformer architecture for semantic, instance and panoptic segmentation.

title: Photorealistic Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Deep Language Understanding
authors: Saharia C, Chan W, Saxena S, Li L, Whang J, Denton E, et al.
summary: Imagen: cascaded pixel diffusion conditioned on a frozen T5 text encoder, showing language-model scale matters most.

title: Video Diffusion Models
authors: Ho J, Salimans T, Gritsenko A, Chan W, Norouzi M, Fleet DJ
summary: Extended diffusion models to video with a space-time factorized 3D U-Net and joint image-video training.

title: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces
authors: Gu A, Goel K, Ré C
summary: Introduced S4, a structured state-space sequence layer with efficient convolutional computation that excelled at very long-range dependencies.

title: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
authors: Wei J, Tay Y, Bommasani R, Raffel C, Zoph B, Borgeaud S, et al.
summary: Catalogued abilities that appear abruptly only above certain model scales, influencing debate on scaling.

title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
authors: Dao T, Fu DY, Ermon S, Rudra A, Ré C
summary: IO-aware tiled exact attention that avoids materializing the attention matrix, greatly speeding up Transformers and enabling long contexts.

title: Grokking: Generalization Beyond Overfitting on Small Algorithmic Datasets
authors: Power A, Burda Y, Edwards H, Babuschkin I, Misra V
summary: Discovered grokking: networks generalize long after overfitting small algorithmic tasks.

title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
authors: Fedus W, Zoph B, Shazeer N
summary: Simplified MoE to top-1 routing, training trillion-parameter sparse models with large speedups over dense baselines.

title: Tensor Programs V: Tuning Large Neural Networks via Zero-Shot Hyperparameter Transfer
authors: Yang G, Hu EJ, Babuschkin I, Sidor S, Liu X, Farhi D, et al.
summary: Introduced the Maximal Update Parametrization (muP), under which optimal hyperparameters transfer from small to large models.

title: Toy Models of Superposition
authors: Elhage N, Hume T, Olsson C, Schiefer N, Henighan T, Kravec S, et al.
summary: Showed networks represent more features than dimensions via superposition, explaining polysemantic neurons.

title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
authors: Hoffmann J, Borgeaud S, Mensch A, Buchatskaya E, Cai T, Rutherford E, et al.
summary: Chinchilla: showed parameters and training tokens should scale equally with compute, revealing earlier LLMs as undertrained.

title: Mapping information-rich genotype-phenotype landscapes with genome-scale Perturb-seq
authors: Replogle JM, Saunders RA, Pogson AN, Hussmann JA, Lenail A, Guna A, et al.
summary: Genome-scale CRISPRi Perturb-seq profiling transcriptional effects of perturbing every expressed gene.

title: Real-time dynamic single-molecule protein sequencing on an integrated semiconductor device
authors: Reed BD, Meyer MJ, Abramzon V, Ad O, Ad P, Adcock P, et al.
summary: Single-molecule protein sequencing by kinetic recognition of N-terminal amino acids on a semiconductor chip (Quantum-Si).

title: The Tabula Sapiens: a multiple-organ, single-cell transcriptomic atlas of humans
authors: Tabula Sapiens Consortium
summary: Human cell atlas of ~500,000 cells from 24 organs of the same donors.

title: The complete sequence of a human genome
authors: Nurk S, Koren S, Rhie A, Rautiainen M, Bzikadze AV, Mikheenko A, et al.
summary: T2T-CHM13: the first gapless human genome, adding ~200 Mb including centromeres and rDNA arrays.

title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation
authors: Li J, Li D, Xiong C, Hoi S
summary: Unified vision-language encoder-decoder pretraining with caption bootstrapping to clean noisy web image-text data.

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
authors: Wei J, Wang X, Schuurmans D, Bosma M, Ichter B, Xia F, et al.
summary: Showed that prompting with step-by-step reasoning exemplars dramatically improves LLM arithmetic, commonsense and symbolic reasoning.

title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
authors: Bai Y, Kadavath S, Kundu S, Askell A, Kernion J, Jones A, et al.
summary: Trained harmless assistants using a written constitution and AI-generated critiques and preferences (RLAIF) instead of human harm labels.

title: Finetuned Language Models Are Zero-Shot Learners
authors: Wei J, Bosma M, Zhao VY, Guu K, Yu AW, Lester B, et al.
summary: FLAN: instruction tuning on many tasks phrased as natural-language instructions markedly improves zero-shot performance on unseen tasks.

title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
authors: Alayrac JB, Donahue J, Luc P, Miech A, Barr I, Hasson Y, et al.
summary: Bridged frozen vision encoders and LLMs with gated cross-attention and a perceiver resampler, enabling few-shot multimodal in-context learning on interleaved image-text.

title: Improving Language Models by Retrieving from Trillions of Tokens
authors: Borgeaud S, Mensch A, Hoffmann J, Cai T, Rutherford E, Millican K, et al.
summary: RETRO: chunked cross-attention to a 2-trillion-token retrieval database let a 7.5B model match far larger LMs.

title: Introducing ChatGPT
authors: OpenAI
summary: Public release of an RLHF-tuned conversational GPT-3.5 model whose rapid adoption brought LLMs into mainstream use.

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
authors: Hu EJ, Shen Y, Wallis P, Allen-Zhu Z, Li Y, Wang S, et al.
summary: Freezes pretrained weights and trains low-rank update matrices, cutting fine-tuning memory and storage by orders of magnitude; the dominant PEFT method.

title: Multitask Prompted Training Enables Zero-Shot Task Generalization
authors: Sanh V, Webson A, Raffel C, Bach SH, Sutawika L, Alyafeai Z, et al.
summary: T0: multitask fine-tuning of T5 on a large collection of prompted datasets yields strong zero-shot generalization.

title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
authors: Chowdhery A, Narang S, Devlin J, Bosma M, Mishra G, Roberts A, et al.
summary: A 540B dense Transformer trained on Pathways showing breakthrough few-shot and chain-of-thought reasoning performance.

title: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models
authors: Chung HW, Hou L, Longpre S, Zoph B, Tay Y, Fedus W, et al.
summary: Flan-T5/Flan-PaLM: scaled instruction tuning to 1,800+ tasks with chain-of-thought data, improving many model families.

title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback
authors: Ouyang L, Wu J, Jiang X, Almeida D, Wainwright CL, Mishkin P, et al.
summary: InstructGPT: supervised instruction tuning plus RLHF made a 1.3B model preferred over 175B GPT-3, the recipe behind ChatGPT.

title: A Generalist Agent
authors: Reed S, Zolna K, Parisotto E, Colmenarejo SG, Novikov A, Barth-Maron G, et al.
summary: Gato is a single transformer trained by supervised imitation on hundreds of tasks, including Atari, captioning, chat and robot control, all serialized as tokens. It was an early step toward generalist agents.

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Q-Learning
authors: Kostrikov I, Nair A, Levine S
summary: IQL avoids querying unseen actions by fitting values with expectile regression and extracting the policy by advantage-weighted regression. Simple and strong, it is widely used for offline and offline-to-online RL.

title: STaR: Bootstrapping Reasoning With Reasoning
authors: Zelikman E, Wu Y, Mu J, Goodman ND
subfield: RL from human feedback & for LLMs
summary: A language model generates rationales, keeps those that reach correct answers and fine-tunes on them, iteratively improving its reasoning. A precursor of RL with verifiable rewards.

title: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
authors: Bai Y, Jones A, Ndousse K, Askell A, Chen A, DasSarma N, et al.
subfield: RL from human feedback & for LLMs
summary: Applied RLHF to train helpful and harmless assistants, studied the tension between the two goals and iterated online with fresh human feedback. Its HH dataset became widely used.

title: Anti-CD19 CAR T cell therapy for refractory systemic lupus erythematosus
authors: Mackensen A, Müller F, Mougiakakos D, Böltz S, Wilhelm A, Aigner M, et al.
summary: CD19 CAR-T induced drug-free remission in refractory lupus, extending CAR-T from cancer to autoimmune disease (followed by a 2024 NEJM case series).

title: GD2-CAR T cell therapy for diffuse midline gliomas
authors: Majzner RG, Ramakrishna S, Yeom KW, Patel S, Chinnasamy H, Schultz LM, et al.
summary: GD2-directed CAR-T cells produced responses in lethal pediatric gliomas, a step toward CAR-T for solid tumors.

title: Trastuzumab deruxtecan in previously treated HER2-low advanced breast cancer
authors: Modi S, Jacot W, Yamashita T, Sohn J, Vidal M, Tokunaga E, et al.
summary: DESTINY-Breast04 showed a next-generation ADC benefits HER2-low tumors, redefining a new targetable breast cancer population.

title: De novo design of protein structure and function with RFdiffusion
authors: Watson JL, Juergens D, Bennett NR, Trippe BL, Yim J, Eisenach HE, et al.
summary: Fine-tuned RoseTTAFold as a denoising diffusion model over backbones, enabling design of binders, symmetric assemblies and motif scaffolds with high success.

title: DiffDock: Diffusion steps, twists, and turns for molecular docking
authors: Corso G, Stärk H, Jing B, Barzilay R, Jaakkola T
summary: Framed docking as generative diffusion over ligand translations, rotations and torsions, outperforming search-based docking on blind benchmarks.

title: Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic-level protein structure with a language model
authors: Lin Z, Akin H, Rao R, Hie B, Zhu Z, Lu W, et al.
summary: ESM-2 and ESMFold predicted structures from single sequences with a protein language model, enabling the ~600-million-structure ESM Metagenomic Atlas.

title: Illuminating protein space with a programmable generative model
authors: Ingraham JB, Baranov M, Costello Z, Barber KW, Wang W, Ismail A, et al.
summary: Chroma, a diffusion model over protein complexes with programmable conditioning on symmetry, shape and semantics.

title: Large language models generate functional protein sequences across diverse families
authors: Madani A, Krause B, Greene ER, Subramanian S, Mohr BP, Holton JM, et al.
summary: ProGen, a conditional protein language model, generated artificial lysozymes with natural-like activity despite low sequence identity.

title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
authors: Kerbl B, Kopanas G, Leimkühler T, Drettakis G
summary: Represents scenes as optimized anisotropic 3D Gaussians rasterized differentiably, achieving NeRF-quality view synthesis at real-time frame rates.

title: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
authors: Zhang L, Rao A, Agrawala M
summary: ControlNet: a trainable copy of the diffusion encoder connected via zero-initialized convolutions adds spatial conditions such as edges, depth and pose.

title: DreamFusion: Text-to-3D using 2D Diffusion
authors: Poole B, Jain A, Barron JT, Mildenhall B
summary: Score distillation sampling optimizes a NeRF using a pretrained 2D text-to-image diffusion model, enabling text-to-3D without 3D data.

title: Segment Anything
authors: Kirillov A, Mintun E, Ravi N, Mao H, Rolland C, Gustafson L, et al.
summary: SAM: a promptable segmentation foundation model trained on the SA-1B dataset of over 1 billion masks, with strong zero-shot transfer.

title: Are Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models a Mirage?
authors: Schaeffer R, Miranda B, Koyejo S
summary: Argued many emergent abilities are artifacts of discontinuous evaluation metrics rather than abrupt capability changes.

title: Consistency Models
authors: Song Y, Dhariwal P, Chen M, Sutskever I
summary: Learned to map any point on a probability-flow ODE trajectory to its origin, enabling one- or few-step generation.

title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
authors: Lipman Y, Chen RTQ, Ben-Hamu H, Nickel M, Le M
summary: Simulation-free training of continuous normalizing flows by regressing conditional vector fields, generalizing diffusion and now widely used.

title: Learning Skillful Medium-Range Global Weather Forecasting
authors: Lam R, Sanchez-Gonzalez A, Willson M, Wirnsberger P, Fortunato M, Alet F, et al.
summary: GraphCast: a mesh-based GNN that outperformed leading numerical weather prediction on 10-day forecasts.

title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
authors: Gu A, Dao T
summary: Made state-space parameters input-dependent (selective) with a hardware-aware scan, matching Transformers on language at linear cost in sequence length.

title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
authors: Peebles W, Xie S
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) replaced U-Nets with Transformers on latent patches, showing favorable scaling; the backbone of later video and image generators.

title: Towards Monosemanticity: Decomposing Language Models With Dictionary Learning
authors: Bricken T, Templeton A, Batson J, Chen B, Jermyn A, Conerly T, et al.
summary: Used sparse autoencoders to extract interpretable monosemantic features from superposed transformer activations.

title: A draft human pangenome reference
authors: Liao WW, Asri M, Ebler J, Doerr D, Haukness M, Hickey G, et al.
summary: Human Pangenome Reference Consortium graph of 47 phased diploid assemblies capturing diversity missing from a single linear reference.

title: Accurate proteome-wide missense variant effect prediction with AlphaMissense
authors: Cheng J, Novati G, Pan J, Bycroft C, Žemgulytė A, Applebaum T, et al.
summary: AlphaFold-derived model classifying pathogenicity of all 71 million possible human missense variants.

title: Plasma proteomic associations with genetics and health in the UK Biobank
authors: Sun BB, Chiou J, Traylor M, Benner C, Hsu YH, Richardson TG, et al.
summary: UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project: Olink profiling of ~3,000 proteins in 54,000 people, mapping >14,000 pQTLs.

title: Transfer learning enables predictions in network biology
authors: Theodoris CV, Xiao L, Chopra A, Chaffin MD, Al Sayed ZR, Hill MC, et al.
summary: Geneformer: transformer pretrained on ~30 million single-cell transcriptomes, fine-tuned for network-biology predictions.

title: Approval of exagamglogene autotemcel (Casgevy), the first CRISPR-based therapy
authors: US Food and Drug Administration
venue: FDA Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research approval announcement
summary: Regulatory approval of a CRISPR-edited cell therapy for sickle cell disease, eleven years after the Cas9 programmability papers.

title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
authors: Li J, Li D, Savarese S, Hoi S
summary: A lightweight Querying Transformer connects frozen image encoders to frozen LLMs, giving strong VLMs at low training cost.

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
authors: Rafailov R, Sharma A, Mitchell E, Ermon S, Manning CD, Finn C
summary: Derived a closed-form classification loss that optimizes the RLHF objective directly from preferences without a separate reward model or RL.

title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
authors: Leviathan Y, Kalman M, Matias Y
summary: A small draft model proposes tokens that the large model verifies in parallel, giving 2-3x speedups with identical output distribution.

title: GPT-4 Technical Report
authors: OpenAI
summary: Large multimodal model reaching human-level performance on many professional and academic exams, with predictable scaling of training outcomes.

title: GPT-4V(ision) System Card
authors: OpenAI
summary: Deployment of GPT-4 with image input, bringing general visual understanding to a widely used assistant.

title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers
authors: Frantar E, Ashkboos S, Hoefler T, Alistarh D
summary: One-shot second-order weight quantization to 3-4 bits for GPT-scale models, enabling LLM inference on single GPUs.

title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
authors: Gemini Team, Google
summary: Natively multimodal models trained jointly on text, images, audio and video, reporting the first human-expert-level MMLU score.

title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
authors: Liang P, Bommasani R, Lee T, Tsipras D, Soylu D, Yasunaga M, et al.
summary: HELM: standardized multi-metric evaluation of many LLMs across scenarios, covering accuracy, calibration, robustness, bias and efficiency.

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
authors: Zheng L, Chiang WL, Sheng Y, Zhuang S, Wu Z, Zhuang Y, et al.
summary: Validated strong LLMs as scalable judges of chat quality and introduced MT-Bench and crowdsourced Chatbot Arena evaluation.

title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
authors: Touvron H, Lavril T, Izacard G, Martinet X, Lachaux MA, Lacroix T, et al.
summary: Openly released 7B-65B models trained compute-optimally on public data, matching much larger models and catalyzing the open-weight LLM ecosystem.

title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
authors: Touvron H, Martin L, Stone K, Albert P, Almahairi A, Babaei Y, et al.
summary: Open-weight 7B-70B base and RLHF-tuned chat models with detailed safety and alignment methodology, licensed for commercial use.

title: Mistral 7B
authors: Jiang AQ, Sablayrolles A, Mensch A, Bamford C, Chaplot DS, de las Casas D, et al.
summary: Compact open model using grouped-query and sliding-window attention that outperformed larger Llama 2 models.

title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
authors: Dettmers T, Pagnoni A, Holtzman A, Zettlemoyer L
summary: Backpropagates through a 4-bit NormalFloat quantized model into LoRA adapters, enabling 65B fine-tuning on a single 48GB GPU.

title: Qwen Technical Report
authors: Bai J, Bai S, Chu Y, Cui Z, Dang K, Deng X, et al.
summary: Alibaba's first Qwen open LLM family, beginning a leading line of multilingual open-weight models.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
authors: Yao S, Zhao J, Yu D, Du N, Shafran I, Narasimhan K, Cao Y
summary: Interleaved reasoning traces with actions such as search calls, the template for modern LLM agents.

title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
authors: Wang X, Wei J, Schuurmans D, Le Q, Chi E, Narang S, et al.
summary: Sampled diverse reasoning paths and took a majority vote over answers, a simple and powerful early form of test-time compute.

title: Self-Instruct: Aligning Language Models with Self-Generated Instructions
authors: Wang Y, Kordi Y, Mishra S, Liu A, Smith NA, Khashabi D, Hajishirzi H
summary: Bootstrapped instruction-tuning data from a model's own generations, inspiring cheap open instruction-tuned models like Alpaca.

title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
authors: Schick T, Dwivedi-Yu J, Dessì R, Raileanu R, Lomeli M, Zettlemoyer L, et al.
summary: Self-supervised method for a model to learn when and how to call APIs such as calculators, search and translation.

title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
authors: Yao S, Yu D, Zhao J, Shafran I, Griffiths TL, Cao Y, Narasimhan K
summary: Generalized chain-of-thought to tree search over intermediate thoughts with self-evaluation and backtracking.

title: Visual Instruction Tuning
authors: Liu H, Li C, Wu Q, Lee YJ
summary: LLaVA: connected CLIP to an LLM with a projection and tuned on GPT-4-generated visual instruction data, a simple recipe behind open multimodal assistants.

title: Champion-level drone racing using deep reinforcement learning
authors: Kaufmann E, Bauersfeld L, Loquercio A, Muller M, Koltun V, Scaramuzza D
summary: Swift, a drone using only onboard sensors and a policy trained in simulation with RL, beat human world champions in real-world drone racing. It was the first time an autonomous system beat champions in a competitive physical sport.

title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
authors: Chi C, Feng S, Du Y, Xu Z, Cousineau E, Burchfiel B, et al.
summary: Represents a robot visuomotor policy as a conditional denoising diffusion process over action sequences. This handles multimodal demonstrations well and became a dominant approach to imitation learning.

title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
authors: Hafner D, Pasukonis J, Ba J, Lillicrap T
venue: arXiv 2023; Nature 2025 as 'Mastering diverse control tasks through world models'
summary: DreamerV3 uses robust normalization so that one fixed set of hyperparameters works across many domains. It was the first agent to collect diamonds in Minecraft from scratch, without human data.

title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale
authors: Brohan A, Brown N, Carbajal J, Chebotar Y, Dabis J, Finn C, et al.
summary: A transformer policy trained on 130k real robot episodes covering more than 700 language-specified tasks. It showed that large, diverse robot data and high-capacity models improve generalization.

title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
authors: Brohan A, Brown N, Carbajal J, Chebotar Y, Chen X, Choromanski K, et al.
summary: Co-fine-tuned large vision-language models on web data and robot trajectories, with actions written as text tokens, creating vision-language-action (VLA) models. They transfer semantic knowledge from the web to robot control.

title: Lecanemab in early Alzheimer's disease
authors: van Dyck CH, Swanson CJ, Aisen P, Bateman RJ, Chen C, Gee M, et al.
summary: CLARITY AD trial: an anti-amyloid protofibril antibody modestly slowed cognitive decline, leading to full approval of the first disease-modifying Alzheimer's antibody.

title: Personalized RNA neoantigen vaccines stimulate T cells in pancreatic cancer
authors: Rojas LA, Sethna Z, Soares KC, Olcese C, Pang N, Patterson E, et al.
summary: Individualized mRNA neoantigen vaccines (autogene cevumeran) induced durable T cells correlated with delayed recurrence in pancreatic cancer.

title: Respiratory syncytial virus prefusion F protein vaccine in older adults
authors: Papi A, Ison MG, Langley JM, Lee DG, Leroux-Roels I, Martinon-Torres F, et al.
summary: AReSVi-006 trial of an adjuvanted prefusion-F vaccine, leading to the first approved RSV vaccines in 2023.

title: A small-molecule TNIK inhibitor targets fibrosis in preclinical and clinical models
authors: Ren F, Aliper A, Chen J, Zhao H, Rao S, Kuppe C, et al.
summary: Described INS018_055 (rentosertib), an AI-nominated target and AI-generated TNIK inhibitor for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis that advanced to positive phase 2a trials.

title: Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3
authors: Abramson J, Adler J, Dunger J, Evans R, Green T, Pritzel A, et al.
summary: AlphaFold 3 replaced the structure module with a diffusion model to predict joint structures of proteins, nucleic acids, ligands, ions and modifications.

title: Boltz-1: Democratizing biomolecular interaction modeling
authors: Wohlwend J, Corso G, Passaro S, Reveiz M, Leidal K, Swiderski W, et al.
summary: The first fully open-source model reaching AlphaFold 3-level accuracy on biomolecular complexes, with code and weights under a permissive license.

title: Discovery of a structural class of antibiotics with explainable deep learning
authors: Wong F, Zheng EJ, Valeri JA, Donghia NM, Anahtar MN, Omori S, et al.
summary: Explainable graph neural network substructure search discovered a new structural class of antibiotics active against MRSA.

title: Generalized biomolecular modeling and design with RoseTTAFold All-Atom
authors: Krishna R, Wang J, Ahern W, Sturmfels P, Venkatesh P, Kalvet I, et al.

title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2024: computational protein design and protein structure prediction
authors: Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences (laureates Baker D, Hassabis D, Jumper J)
summary: Awarded half to David Baker for computational protein design and half to Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for AlphaFold protein structure prediction.

title: Rapid in silico directed evolution by a protein language model with EVOLVEpro
authors: Jiang K, Yan Z, Di Bernardo M, Sgrizzi SR, Villiger L, Kayabolen A, et al.
summary: Combined protein language model embeddings with few-shot active learning to evolve antibodies, CRISPR nucleases and other proteins in few rounds.

title: DUSt3R: Geometric 3D Vision Made Easy
authors: Wang S, Leroy V, Cabon Y, Chidlovskii B, Revaud J
summary: Regresses dense pointmaps from uncalibrated image pairs with a transformer, unifying calibration, pose and reconstruction without classical SfM.

title: Depth Anything: Unleashing the Power of Large-Scale Unlabeled Data
authors: Yang L, Kang B, Huang Z, Xu X, Feng J, Zhao H
summary: Monocular depth foundation model trained with pseudo-labels on ~62M unlabeled images on a DINOv2 encoder, with strong zero-shot generalization.

title: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-Training for Open-Set Object Detection
authors: Liu S, Zeng Z, Ren T, Li F, Zhang H, Yang J, et al.
summary: Open-vocabulary detector fusing language and vision in a DETR-style architecture, detecting arbitrary objects from text prompts.

title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos
authors: Ravi N, Gabeur V, Hu YT, Hu R, Ryali C, Ma T, et al.
summary: Extended SAM to video with a streaming memory architecture for promptable video object segmentation, trained on the SA-V dataset.

title: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
authors: Esser P, Kulal S, Blattmann A, Entezari R, Müller J, Saini H, et al.
summary: Stable Diffusion 3: rectified-flow training with a multimodal diffusion transformer (MM-DiT), scaling to 8B parameters.

title: Video generation models as world simulators
authors: Brooks T, Peebles B, Holmes C, DePue W, Guo Y, Jing L, et al.
summary: Sora: a diffusion transformer over spacetime latent patches generating minute-long, high-fidelity videos, marking a leap in video generation.

title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction
authors: Tian K, Jiang Y, Yuan Z, Peng B, Wang L
summary: VAR: coarse-to-fine next-scale autoregressive prediction that outperforms diffusion transformers on ImageNet; NeurIPS 2024 best paper.

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
authors: DeepSeek-AI
builds_on: fedus2022switch micikevicius2018mixed rajbhandari2020zero jiang2024mixtral dubey2024llama shazeer2017outrageously
summary: 671B-parameter MoE model trained at low cost using FP8 mixed precision, multi-head latent attention and communication-overlapping pipeline parallelism.

title: KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
authors: Liu Z, Wang Y, Vaidya S, Ruehle F, Halverson J, Soljačić M, et al.
summary: Proposed networks with learnable spline activation functions on edges, inspired by the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem, as an interpretable alternative to MLPs.

title: Muon: An Optimizer for Hidden Layers in Neural Networks
authors: Jordan K, et al.
summary: Introduced Muon, which orthogonalizes momentum updates for matrix parameters via Newton-Schulz iteration; adopted for large-scale LLM pretraining in 2025.

title: Nobel Prize in Physics 2024: for foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks
authors: Hopfield JJ, Hinton GE
summary: The physics Nobel recognized Hopfield networks and Boltzmann machines as foundations of modern machine learning.

title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally can be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters
authors: Snell C, Lee J, Xu K, Kumar A
summary: Studied compute-optimal allocation of inference-time computation, showing test-time scaling can substitute for larger models.

title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
authors: Dao T, Gu A
summary: Showed a duality between selective SSMs and structured masked attention, yielding the faster Mamba-2 architecture.

title: xLSTM: Extended Long Short-Term Memory
authors: Beck M, Pöppel K, Spanring M, Auer A, Prudnikova O, Kopp M, et al.
summary: Revived LSTMs at LLM scale with exponential gating and matrix memory, competing with Transformers and SSMs.

title: Genomic data in the All of Us Research Program
authors: All of Us Research Program Genomics Investigators
summary: Release of ~245,000 clinical-grade whole genomes from a diverse US cohort.

title: Sequence modeling and design from molecular to genome scale with Evo
authors: Nguyen E, Poli M, Durrant MG, Kang B, Katrekar D, Li DB, et al.
summary: Evo: a 7B-parameter long-context genomic foundation model trained on prokaryotic genomes for prediction and generation of DNA, RNA and protein.

title: Sequencing by avidity enables high accuracy with low reagent consumption
authors: Arslan S, Garcia FJ, Guo M, Kellinger MW, Kruglyak S, LeVieux JA, et al.
summary: Element Biosciences avidity sequencing using multivalent dye-labelled polymers, a new high-accuracy short-read chemistry.

title: Ultra-fast label-free quantification and comprehensive proteome coverage with narrow-window data-independent acquisition
authors: Guzman UH, Martinez-Val A, Ye Z, Damoc E, Arrey TN, Pashkova A, et al.
summary: Orbitrap Astral narrow-window DIA quantifying near-complete human proteomes in short gradients.

title: scGPT: toward building a foundation model for single-cell multi-omics using generative AI
authors: Cui H, Wang C, Maan H, Pang K, Luo F, Duan N, et al.
summary: Generative transformer pretrained on over 33 million cells for annotation, integration and perturbation prediction.

title: Bridge RNAs direct programmable recombination of target and donor DNA
authors: Durrant MG, Perry NT, Pai JJ, Jangid AR, Athukoralage JS, Hiraizumi M, et al.
summary: IS110 insertion sequences use a bicistronic bridge RNA specifying both target and donor, giving a programmable recombinase that inserts, inverts and excises DNA.

title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
authors: Shao Z, Wang P, Zhu Q, Xu R, Song J, Bi X, et al.
summary: Introduced Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a critic-free RL method later central to open reasoning models.

title: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking Multimodal Understanding across Millions of Tokens of Context
authors: Gemini Team, Google
summary: MoE multimodal model with near-perfect recall over contexts of up to 10M tokens across text, audio and video.

title: Hello GPT-4o
authors: OpenAI
summary: End-to-end omni model processing text, audio and vision in one network, enabling real-time spoken conversation.

title: Introducing computer use, a new Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Claude 3.5 Haiku
authors: Anthropic
summary: First frontier model offered with general computer use, operating desktop GUIs via screenshots, mouse and keyboard actions.

title: Learning to Reason with LLMs
authors: OpenAI
summary: o1 models trained with large-scale RL to produce long hidden chains of thought, showing performance scales with test-time reasoning compute.

title: Let's Verify Step by Step
authors: Lightman H, Kosaraju V, Burda Y, Edwards H, Baker B, Lee T, et al.
summary: Showed process supervision of each reasoning step trains better reward models than outcome supervision, releasing the PRM800K dataset.

title: Mixtral of Experts
authors: Jiang AQ, Sablayrolles A, Roux A, Mensch A, Savary B, Bamford C, et al.
summary: Open sparse mixture-of-experts model (8 experts, 2 active) matching much larger dense models at lower inference cost.

title: Model Context Protocol
authors: Anthropic
summary: Open protocol standardizing how LLM applications connect to tools and data sources, widely adopted across agent frameworks.

title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
authors: Yang J, Jimenez CE, Wettig A, Lieret K, Yao S, Narasimhan K, Press O
summary: Showed purpose-built agent-computer interfaces let LLM agents navigate repositories and fix real GitHub issues.

title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
authors: Jimenez CE, Yang J, Wettig A, Yao S, Pei K, Press O, Narasimhan K
summary: Benchmark of real GitHub issues from Python repositories, verified by unit tests, that became the main yardstick for coding agents.

title: The Claude 3 Model Family: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku
authors: Anthropic
summary: Frontier multimodal assistant family trained with Constitutional AI and RLHF, emphasizing helpfulness, honesty and harmlessness.

title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
authors: Dubey A, Jauhri A, Pandey A, Kadian A, Al-Dahle A, Letman A, et al.
summary: Open dense models up to 405B parameters trained on ~15T tokens, approaching frontier closed-model quality.

title: Genie: Generative Interactive Environments
authors: Bruce J, Dennis M, Edwards A, Parker-Holder J, Shi Y, Hughes E, et al.
summary: A foundation world model trained without action labels on internet gameplay videos that learns latent actions and generates controllable, playable environments. It points to generative models as unlimited training grounds for agents.

title: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
authors: Open X-Embodiment Collaboration, O'Neill A, Rehman A, Gupta A, Maddukuri A, Gupta A, et al.
summary: Pooled over a million robot trajectories from 22 robot embodiments across many institutions, and showed that RT-X models trained on the mixture transfer positively across robots.

authors: Kim MJ, Pertsch K, Karamcheti S, Xiao T, Balakrishna A, Nair S, et al.
summary: A 7B-parameter open vision-language-action model built on Llama 2 and trained on Open X-Embodiment data. It outperformed larger closed models and made VLA research widely accessible.

title: Tulu 3: Pushing Frontiers in Open Language Model Post-Training
authors: Lambert N, Morrison J, Pyatkin V, Huang S, Ivison H, Brahman F, et al.
subfield: RL from human feedback & for LLMs
summary: An openly released post-training recipe, with data, code and models, combining SFT, DPO and RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on tasks with checkable answers.

title: pi0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
authors: Black K, Brown N, Driess D, Esmail A, Equi M, Finn C, et al.
summary: Physical Intelligence's pi0 attaches a flow-matching action expert to a pretrained vision-language model and trains it on diverse cross-embodiment data. It performs dexterous, long-horizon tasks such as laundry folding.

title: A cell-free DNA blood-based test for colorectal cancer screening
authors: Chung DC, Gray DM 2nd, Singh H, Issaka RB, Raymond VM, Eagle C, et al.
summary: ECLIPSE study supporting the first FDA-approved blood test (Shield) for primary colorectal cancer screening.

title: Individualised neoantigen therapy mRNA-4157 (V940) plus pembrolizumab versus pembrolizumab monotherapy in resected melanoma (KEYNOTE-942): a randomised, phase 2b study
authors: Weber JS, Carlino MS, Khattak A, Meniawy T, Ansstas G, Taylor MH, et al.
summary: Randomized evidence that a personalized mRNA cancer vaccine added to anti-PD-1 reduces melanoma recurrence.

title: Safety and efficacy of malaria vaccine candidate R21/Matrix-M in African children: a multicentre, double-blind, randomised, phase 3 trial
authors: Datoo MS, Dicko A, Tinto H, Ouédraogo JB, Hamaluba M, Olotu A, et al.
summary: Phase 3 results for R21/Matrix-M, a circumsporozoite-HBsAg VLP malaria vaccine recommended by WHO for children.

title: Genome modeling and design across all domains of life with Evo 2
authors: Brixi G, Durrant MG, Ku J, Poli M, Brockman G, Chang D, et al.

authors: Hayes T, Rao R, Akin H, Sofroniew NJ, Oktay D, Lin Z, et al.

title: DINOv3
authors: Siméoni O, Vo HV, Seitzer M, Baldassarre F, Oquab M, Jose C, et al.
summary: Scaled DINO-style self-supervised training to a 7B-parameter ViT on 1.7B images, with Gram anchoring to keep dense features high quality.

title: VGGT: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
authors: Wang J, Chen M, Karaev N, Vedaldi A, Rupprecht C, Novotny D
summary: Feed-forward transformer that predicts cameras, depth, pointmaps and tracks from many views in one pass; CVPR 2025 best paper.

authors: Geng Z, Deng M, Bai X, Kolter JZ, He K
summary: Models average rather than instantaneous velocity fields, achieving strong one-step generation trained from scratch.

title: Simplifying, Stabilizing and Scaling Continuous-Time Consistency Models

title: AlphaGenome: advancing regulatory variant effect prediction with a unified DNA sequence model
authors: Avsec Ž, Latysheva N, Cheng J, Novati G, Taylor KR, Ward T, et al.
summary: Megabase-context sequence model jointly predicting thousands of functional genomic tracks at base resolution for regulatory variant-effect prediction.

title: Complete sequencing of ape genomes
authors: Yoo D, Rhie A, Hebbar P, Antonacci F, Logsdon GA, Solar SJ, et al.
summary: Telomere-to-telomere diploid genomes of six ape species, enabling complete comparative analysis of great-ape genome evolution.

title: Whole-genome sequencing of 490,640 UK Biobank participants
authors: UK Biobank Whole-Genome Sequencing Consortium
summary: Whole genomes for nearly all UK Biobank participants, cataloguing ~1.5 billion variants for biobank-scale rare-variant studies.

title: Patient-specific in vivo gene editing to treat a rare genetic disease
authors: Musunuru K, Grandinette SA, Wang X, Hudson TR, Briseno K, Berry AM, et al.
summary: A bespoke in vivo base-editing therapy designed and dosed for one infant with CPS1 deficiency, the first personalised genome-editing medicine.

title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
authors: DeepSeek-AI
summary: Showed pure RL with verifiable rewards (GRPO) elicits long chain-of-thought reasoning; released open reasoning weights and distilled models rivaling o1.

title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
authors: Comanici G, et al.
summary: Thinking-enabled Gemini models combining million-token context, native multimodality and agentic capabilities.

title: Introducing Claude 4
authors: Anthropic
summary: Claude Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 hybrid-reasoning models targeted at long-running agentic coding, leading SWE-bench at release.

title: Introducing GPT-5
authors: OpenAI
summary: Unified system routing between fast and extended-reasoning models, with strong coding and agentic tool-use performance.

title: Qwen3 Technical Report
authors: Yang A, Li A, Yang B, Zhang B, Hui B, Zheng B, et al.
summary: Open dense and MoE models unifying thinking and non-thinking modes with a controllable reasoning budget.

authors: Yue Y, Chen Z, Lu R, Zhao A, Wang Z, Song S, et al.

summary: Using pass@k at large k, found that RL with verifiable rewards mainly sharpens sampling toward reasoning paths the base model already contains, rather than adding new ones. A widely discussed analysis of what RL adds to LLMs.

title: Phase I trial of hES cell-derived dopaminergic neurons for Parkinson's disease
authors: Tabar V, Sarva H, Lozano AM, et al.
summary: First-in-human trial of embryonic stem cell-derived dopaminergic progenitors (bemdaneprocel) showing graft survival and safety in Parkinson's disease.

authors: Reichman TW, Markmann JF, Odorico J, et al.
